diagnosis.root_cause: The robot's pose estimate became unreliable due to a large jump (2.51 m, 0.53 rad) at 22.5 s following an external reset at 22.3 s. This was caused by lidar scans appearing as 'wall-sized structures' where the map is free, indicating severe sensor-to-map misalignment. The resulting incorrect pose prevented the planner from finding a valid path to PICK_B.
evidence: pose estimate jumped 2.51 m and 0.53 rad at 22.5 s
external pose reset set estimate to (-4.67, -3.68) at 22.3 s
two wall-sized structures appeared where map is free (lidar scans not lining up with map)
planner failed to find a path 21 times
